items.heading: An Rbi Circular Reported
items.text: An RBI circular reported in April 2025 lets a minor aged 10 or more run a savings account on their own, within the amount and terms each bank sets. Younger minors use a guardian. Overdrafts are not allowed.

items.heading: A Simple Offer a Simple
items.text: A Simple Offer A simple offer. One result, one price, one delivery date, in three lines.

items.heading: Under Indian Contract Law, Under
items.text: Under Indian Contract Law, Under Indian contract law, an agreement made by a minor (under 18) is treated as void, not just risky. The Privy Council decided this in Mohori Bibee v Dharmodas Ghose (1903), and later court summaries say the Supreme Court repeated it in 2014.

columns: What it means for a student
rows: A minor's income is normally added to the income of the parent who earns more. Income from the child's own skill, talent or manual work is excluded, but returns from investing that money are added. The rule is section 64(1A) of the old Act and moves to section 99(1A) under the Income-tax Act, 2025, which applies from 1 April 2026.
Tell your parents about your earnings. Ask a CA how to file. Do not hide income to keep things simple.

Secondary explainers give GST registration limits for service providers of Rs 20 lakh a year (Rs 10 lakh in special category states). E-commerce operators and some other cases need registration whatever the turnover, and platforms differ on what they accept.

A small service business is far below the limit. If you sell goods through Amazon, Meesho or a similar platform, read the platform's current seller page and check gst.gov.in first. Udyam registration for small businesses is free and optional, but it needs an adult's Aadhaar, so ask a CA before you try it.

items.heading: Positioning
items.text: Positioning. Say who you help and with what, in one sentence. "I make menus for cafes in this area" beats "I design.".

items.heading: Proof
items.text: Proof. Three finished examples and one line from a real customer.

items.heading: Follow
items.text: Follow-up. Most students send one message and quit. Send a polite second message with something new, such as a new sample.

items.heading: Referrals
items.text: Referrals. Ask right after a good result: "Who else do you know who needs this?".
